They also should work with the new hormonal and primitive body shapes available in makehuman now. Also most are useful individually to alter one specific area of the body. Some targets are quite strong and therefore a gentle hand may be needed for desired results however this allows them to work with ssbw bodies also. When mixing the targets together an especially delicate touch is needed to achieve a realistic shape. That being said at times targets do not play nicely with certain clothing items or stock sliders etc. As time allows I will upload as many of these finished targets as possible firstly female then male. Ty to Ricardo and the makehuman Devs for the help and inspiration on the process in this ongoing project. These targets in the project are all CC0.

What coincidence Warning: mesh uses both tris and quads. The current release of MakeHuman doesn't seem to have a problem with it: it shows up correctly and exports correctly to Blender including rigging. It may not work for everyone's system/MH release though so use with caution. It may export incorrectly crash MakeHuman fry your computer or release the nuclear codes to a bloke called Donald. Oh wait that last one's already been done nevermind Known issues: - Using Blender Subsurf modifier after importing from mhx2 may crash Blender or cause other issues. Doing a degenerate dissolve on the dress after import seems to fix this issue although Blender says nothing happened . - As is the case with pretty much all dresses extreme poses may look awkward. Two additional materials are available at the materials page: http://www.makehumancommunity.org/materials.html. Attribution not required but always appreciated

mindfront_ballet_dress_the_swan.author: Mindfront
mindfront_ballet_dress_the_swan.description: Tags: female ballet work. I don't know anything about ballet but this is my/our interpretation of a ballet dress and was created together with a friend who did the basic design. It is primary made for subsurf level 2. I have done extra edge loops to tighten the edges to avoid texture distortion when using modifiers. The skirt is three vertex hard body to maintain its shape. The chest ruffle is not displaced and if you think the normal map is to strong you can reduce the effect by painting over the area with RGB color 128 128 256 in Blender 0.5 0.5 1.0 and low strength brush. In MakeHuman viewport the transparent will not show in favor of the normal map. In Blender use the modifier 'Solidify' and about 2 to 3 mm thickness and 'Fill Rim' and 'Only Rim' to give the fabric some thickness. In Blender Cycles: The diffuse texture should also be used as glossy color to make the gold pattern more visible. The specular map is also used to adjust glossy roughness use a 'Invert'-node and connect it to the glossy shader 'Roughness' to get tiny almost not noticeable glitter effect on the gold pattern.

mindfront_f_dress_01.author: Mindfront
mindfront_f_dress_01.description: Tags: Female Elegant. A Cocktail Dress was my intention looks more like a funeral outfit. The texture colors looks terrible in Blender Cycles I don't know why. One solution is to use the Gamma node and set it on something like 0.7 or 0.8 to adjust OR just change the colors to something better. Updated 2017-07-15 Better deformations than the previous version especially the skirt part.

mindfront_f_dress_02.author: Mindfront
mindfront_f_dress_02.description: Tags: Female Casual. A simple summer dress. Hard to make loose fitting clothes especially at the chest at least with my knowledge so far. The seams at the back above the shoulder blades will be deformed when subsurfed without extra edgeloops. If you use Blender use the Sculpt Mode with Clay and Smooth brush at low strength to adjust deformation and fitness. Updated 2017-07-15 Better deformations than the previous version especially the skirt part.

mindfront_f_dress_03.author: Mindfront
mindfront_f_dress_03.description: Tags: Female Elegant. My interpretation of a vintage weddingdress. I am experimenting on making more advanced clothes. Some areas may overlap each other especially on the skirt. I tried to make the belt buckle more static to avoid strong deformation. The flower pattern have some mismatching areas but it shouldn't be noticeably. If you use Blender use the Sculpt Mode with Clay and Smooth brush at low strength to adjust deformation and fitness. Updated 2017-07-15 The skirt part now use rigid groups to keep its form as I could not get it to deform smoothly otherwise.

mindfront_f_dress_04.author: Mindfront
mindfront_f_dress_04.description: Tags: Female Elegant. Not as much folds on this one as I thought of comfortable spandex like fabric. I made the buckle a hard body but in some cases it will loose its rectangular geometry. The diffuse texture and specular map looks the same but they are not. The specular map is specially made for Blender Cycles and should be set to 'Non-Color Data'. In Blender Cycles you can also use the specular map to get different glossy roughness between the fabric and the metal parts. Add a 'math'-node and set it to 'Multiply' and connect the color output of the specular map into the 'math'-node upper slot and set the value to eg 24 then add a 'Invert'-node and connect the 'Math'-node to the color input of the 'Invert-node' and the 'Invert'-node output to the glossy roughness input. The preview is how the dress should look in Blender Cycles after above settings. Updated 2017-07-15 Made new vertex binding to get some better deformations on the skirt and the belt buckle.

mindfront_f_dress_05.author: Mindfront
mindfront_f_dress_05.description: Tags: Female Elegant. This dress is quite hard to get to deform nicely especially the sleeves Blender's modifier 'Surface Deform' and 'Corrective Smooth' is good help. The base dress is designed by my friend Bellatrix and wanted to share it with MakeHuman community. I am not satisfied with the normal map skirt folds but lesser real folds make it easier to adjust. In Blender use the Solidify modifier with thickness about 1 5mm fill rim and only rim to give the fabric some thickness. I use the slot for displacement for the metal mask texture. The preview image is rendered in Blender Cycles and I used proportional edit sculpt 'Surface Deform' and 'Corrective Smooth' modifier to adjust the dress to fit the character and pose. The fabric looks like it is made of metal but my intention was silk and of some reason appear more pink than intended. The Blender 2.79 material I use can be downloaded here: http://www.makehumancommunity.org/content/f_dress_05_blender_cycles.html

mindfront_f_dress_06.author: Mindfront
mindfront_f_dress_06.description: Tags: Female Elegant. This dress is my own design as I was in making a dress mood. Not so practical in ordinary life but good to have in the closet till New Years Eve. I use the slot for displacement for the metal mask texture. It does not need any subdivision as I accidentally applied one level. In Blender use the Solidify modifier with thickness about 2mm fill rim and only rim to give the fabric some thickness. The preview image is rendered in Blender Cycles and I used proportional edit and sculpt to adjust the dress to fit the character and pose. The Blender 2.79 material I use can be downloaded here: http://www.makehumancommunity.org/content/f_dress_06_blender_cycles.html

mindfront_f_dress_07.author: Mindfront
mindfront_f_dress_07.description: Tags: Female Elegant. A simple two part dress. I use the slot for displacement for the metal mask texture. In Blender use the Solidify modifier with thickness about 2mm fill rim and only rim to give the fabric some thickness. The Blender 2.79 material I use can be downloaded here: http://www.makehumancommunity.org/content/f_dress_07_blender_cycles.html The preview image is rendered in Blender Cycles and I used proportional edit and sculpt to adjust the dress to fit the character and pose.

mindfront_f_dress_08.author: Mindfront
mindfront_f_dress_08.description: Tags: Female Elegant. A dress my own design made of structured fine knitted fabric. It is very simple and low poly but is prepared for and look best with at least one level of subsurf. I use the slot for displacement for the metal mask texture. In Blender use the Solidify modifier with thickness about 3mm fill rim and only rim to give the fabric some thickness. The preview image is rendered in Blender Cycles and I used proportional edit and sculpt to adjust the dress to fit the character and pose. The Blender 2.79 material I use can be downloaded here: http://www.makehumancommunity.org/content/f_dress_08_blender_cycles.html

mindfront_f_dress_09.author: Mindfront
mindfront_f_dress_09.description: Tags: Female Elegant. Inspired by the dress Natalie Portman wore at Golden Globe 2018. The fabric is ment to be velvet. The mesh is medium poly no subdivision is needed but it look better with level 1. I use the slot for displacement for the metal mask texture. In Blender use the Solidify modifier with thickness about 3mm fill rim and only rim to give the fabric some thickness. The preview image is rendered in Blender Cycles and I used proportional edit and sculpt to adjust the dress to fit the character and pose. The Blender 2.79 material I use can be downloaded here: http://www.makehumancommunity.org/content/f_dress_09_blender_cycles.html

mindfront_f_dress_10.author: Mindfront
mindfront_f_dress_10.description: Tags: Female Elegant. This dress is inspired by a dress from the movie Black Panther. At this time I have not seen the movie only the trailer and some pictures. Bellatrix made the fabric pattern. I use the slot for displacement for the metal mask texture. In Blender use the Solidify modifier with thickness about 3mm fill rim and only rim to give the fabric some thickness. The preview image is rendered in Blender Cycles and I used proportional edit and sculpt to adjust the dress to fit the character and pose. The Blender 2.79 material I use can be downloaded here: http://www.makehumancommunity.org/content/f_dress_10_blender_cycles.html

mindfront_f_dress_11.author: Mindfront
mindfront_f_dress_11.description: Bellatrix made this fabric print and design which I textured and MakeHumanized. From now if necessary I will start making also displacement maps for better visualization of larger folds without the need of deliver a high topology mesh. The displacement map is suited for 2x subsurf and in scale 1:1 displacement strength 0.1 . In Blender use the Solidify modifier with thickness about 2.5 mm fill rim and only rim to give the fabric some thickness and if you use displacement modifier solidify modifier must be placed after to avoid distortions of the skirt rim. This time I use the 'Optional bump texture' slot for the metal mask texture. The preview image is rendered in Blender Cycles and I used proportional edit and sculpt to adjust the dress to fit the character and pose.

punkduck_black_cocktail_dress.author: punkduck
punkduck_black_cocktail_dress.description: A cocktail dress which will work best on females with mid size breasts. It will not work for very big sizes. Delete groups are used at the front. A specular map is added. You may also change the zipper in Blender to a metal shader. The dress has been update to work with Asian females as well.

punkduck_evening_gown.author: punkduck
punkduck_evening_gown.description: This evening gown should be used for female characters. Because of the length of the gown there maybe problems for a lot of poses. Especially crossing the legs is not possible. Delete groups are only used in the upper section. In Blender change zipper and decoration in the neck region to another material glass-like or use node setup like similar to the image saved as bump texture. Subdivision surface algorithm in Blender or Makehuman will change the form of the decoration this is intended. The leather litsphere is used in Makehuman to make the normalmap visible. Edit: changed because of problems with Asian characters and specular map added.

punkduck_figure_skating_dress.author: punkduck
punkduck_figure_skating_dress.description: A figure skating dress designed for females. It works best for small or mid-size cup sizes. If you use a bigger cup size use smooth vertex operator in Blender Delete groups are used. A combination with the ballet tights is possible. You should change the material setup similar to the image saved as bump texture otherwise the specular map will not work. An additional material of a red color is available.

punkduck_medieval_dress.author: punkduck
punkduck_medieval_dress.description: A non-historical medieval dress with trumpet sleeves. It can be used for cosplay theatre and as a costume. A normalmap texture is added and delete groups are used for the upper part of the body. When you import this dress in Blender you should connect the color input of the glossy shader to the image texture. The trumpet sleeves may intersect with the body in certain poses. I added a short description how to do the demo pictures in Blender with cloth simulation as a bump texture. When you want to do cloth simulation do not forget to export the complete body because you need it as a collision object.

punkduck_middle_length_qipao.author: punkduck
punkduck_middle_length_qipao.description: I created a modern qipao even that I used the traditional qipao buttons. For all the users who want to understand the history of the dress read https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cheongsam ... The dragon pattern for the texture of the piece of cloth is free https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Datei:Green_Chinese_dragon.PNG I changed it a bit. A normalmap is added and the litspere is used to make it visible. In Blender change color of the glossy shader to a darker grey or connect it with the image texture. Delete groups are used.

punkduck_tube_dress.author: punkduck
punkduck_tube_dress.description: A rather simple tube dress for female characters. As always you have to rework the breast region after you imported it in Blender when your character has big cupsizes usually by smoothing it. In reality you can buy the dress in 6 different colors. I only add the white material. As a material I tried a combination of normal-map and diffuse-texture which works in MH itself. So I took the leather litsphere. When you export it to blender the litsphere does not matter because the materials and textures are added as always.Please read the small tutorial in the forum for other colors. Delete-Vertex group is used now.

punkduck_winter_coat.author: punkduck
punkduck_winter_coat.description: A winter coat with fur stripes for female characters. You may combine it with the sleeveless shirt and the tight jeans. I only added a diffuse texture the fur itself must be generated with the particle system see description in forum user contributions winter coat . The coat uses the delete-group only in the arm and upper body regions. The buckle and part of the belt resize geometrically You may have to push this section up or down when you use smaller or bigger cup-sizes in Blender. Select the buckle and attach a new more shiny material like brass.

elvs_ear_flap_bottom_out.author: Elvaerwyn
elvs_ear_flap_bottom_out.description: An ear target to pull the bottom of ear outwards and enlarged.

elvs_flap_ears_1.author: Elvaerwyn
elvs_flap_ears_1.description: A target to alter the shape of ears out and away from head.

elvs_flap_ears_2.author: Elvaerwyn
elvs_flap_ears_2.description: An ear target to pull ears down and in at bottom to make flap ear more possible.

elvs_flap_ears_3.author: Elvaerwyn
elvs_flap_ears_3.description: An ear target to pull ears out and away from head at center to make flap ears more possible.

jujube_ear_canal.author: jujube
jujube_ear_canal.description: Gives your character a probably not anatomically correct ear canal.

mindfront_ear_details.author: Mindfront
mindfront_ear_details.description: A more detailed ear. This was a real challenge limited by the original geometry. As I had to move many vertices way off their original position some ear assets like earrings will certainly be twisted. Problems on the earlobe have been noticed on african male characters. Tested and look better with subsurf.

mindfront_ear_in.author: Mindfront
mindfront_ear_in.description: This was made to use if the embedded morphs 'Ear wing-shaped' and 'Ear flapped' dont work together with my 'Ear details' target.

rehmanpolanski_ear_flatten.author: RehmanPolanski
rehmanpolanski_ear_flatten.description: This target makes you flatten the ears more to the head.

culturalibre_hand_claws.author: culturalibre
culturalibre_hand_claws.description: Retractable hand claws weapon for superhero.Optional diffuse texture after the fight here: http://www.makehumancommunity.org/content/blood_claws.html . If you don't like superheroes you can use it to make a nice haircut :

culturalibre_hero_kalistick.author: culturalibre
culturalibre_hero_kalistick.description: Hero metal kalistick.Get more textures in the materials section.

culturalibre_hero_kalistick_lefthanded.author: culturalibre
culturalibre_hero_kalistick_lefthanded.description: Metal kalistick for left handed hero.Get more textures in the materials section.

culturalibre_magic_sceptre.author: culturalibre
culturalibre_magic_sceptre.description: Magic sceptre for a wizard.Original 3d model by quaternius.Downloaded from https://opengameart.org/content/lowpoly-rpg.Thanks.

culturalibre_wooden_bow.author: culturalibre
culturalibre_wooden_bow.description: Original wooden bow model by quaternius.Downloaded from https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Z6vYiQxY8W73FXuMWzaTQAg9rzbumnOr.Thanks for sharing More textures in the materials section.

joepal_crude_sword.author: Joel Palmius
joepal_crude_sword.description: An item intended to demonstrate non-deforming vertex groups. Here the entire sword has been assigned to a vertex group called ' sword' note the asterisk . Then on the human exactly three vertices on the edges of the palm of the hand holding the sword have been assigned to ' sword'. This is intended to demo how to create rigid groups which scales linearly with the size of the toon in this case the distance between the three vertices in the palm rather than deform in strange ways.

o4saken_dagger.author: o4saken
o4saken_dagger.description: A little dagger i made sculpting in blender fitted as a strap around the thigh on the average female . use with a nice split skirt or fancy lingerie.

jaldmic_l1a1.author: JALdMIC
jaldmic_l1a1.description: The L1A1 Self-Loading Rifle also known as the SLR Self-Loading Rifle From Wikipedia

jaldmic_m1911a1.author: JALdMIC
jaldmic_m1911a1.description: The M1911 also known as Colt 1911 or Colt Government is a single-action semi-automatic magazine-fed recoil-operated pistol chambered for the .45 ACP cartridge. Wikipedia

punkduck_p-ivy_weapon.author: punkduck
punkduck_p-ivy_weapon.description: A weapon created by O4saken. I got the permission to upload this weapon into the user contributions to allow users to create a complete Poison Ivy cosplay character. Normalmaps are added and made visible by the leather litsphere in Makehuman. All credits goes to O4saken ... thank you

culturalibre_suitcase.author: culturalibre
culturalibre_suitcase.description: Black suitcase.Tris model.Original by Duion.Released under Creative Commons Attribution 3.0.Downloaded from http://www.blendswap.com/blends/view/66594

elvs_sling_purse1.author: Elvaerwyn
elvs_sling_purse1.description: A large practical bag/purse for makehuman female models. Pose for use with asset also included in repository. One simple texture included.

mindfront_tactical_vest_female.author: Mindfront
mindfront_tactical_vest_female.description: Tags: Work Sport Female. For best fitness I did two version this is best fitted for a female character. You may need to adjust the positions of the zipper slider the shoulder straps and the magazine pockets depending on your character deformations as they use rigid groups and I leave it to you to deform sculpt the pockets so they look more soft and natural as I wanted to keep it as low poly as possible dont know why as it doesn't matter for my purposes . The pockets have each three empty magazine for an AK47 i think and as I did not find any information about their dimension I had to improvise thereof the pockets size but I have seen that some tactical vest pockets are this big. It is ment to be used with solidify modifier thickness about 2 mm and Fill Rim - Only Rim or else the pockets and some details wont look as good. The preview image is rendered in Blender Cycles with the pose 'StandingAtEase' by callharvey3d. As I dont yet have made a fitting jacket and trousers I used my 'Tank Top 01' and 'M Trousers 01' with new textures. On the head is my 'Patrol Cap'.

mindfront_tactical_vest_male.author: Mindfront
mindfront_tactical_vest_male.description: Tags: Work Sport Male. For best fitness I did two version this is best fitted for a male character but the zipper part will get uneven on certain bodies. You may need to adjust the positions of the zipper slider the shoulder straps and the magazine pockets depending on your character deformations as they use rigid groups and I leave it to you to deform sculpt the pockets so they look more soft and natural as I wanted to keep it as low poly as possible dont know why as it doesn't matter for my purposes . The pockets have each three empty magazine for an AK47 i think and as I did not find any information about their dimension I had to improvise thereof the pockets size but I have seen that some tactical vest pockets are this big. It is ment to be used with solidify modifier thickness about 2 mm and Fill Rim - Only Rim or else the pockets and some details wont look as good. The preview image is rendered in Blender Cycles with the pose 'Salute' by callharvey3d. As I dont yet have made a fitting jacket and trousers I used my 'Tank Top 01' and 'M Trousers 01' with new textures. On the head is my 'Patrol Cap'.

punkduck_diver_scuba_rig.author: punkduck
punkduck_diver_scuba_rig.description: This diver scuba rig is a co-production of grinsegold who made the geometry and myself. So most of the credits are for him. In Blender you should change the materials a bit. Insert the color output of the texture to the glossy shader. For the silver-like parts you can duplicate the material then delete the fresnel and use a fixed value. In the end you should decrease the roughness of the glossy shader. That's the way the example picture was done. Be aware that parts will deform when changing the geometry or posing the character. You should use this asset with the diver suit. Be aware that these twin hose regulators were used in the 60s and 70s of the last century.

punkduck_electric_guitar.author: punkduck
punkduck_electric_guitar.description: I decided to get Makehuman to the limits and created a e-guitar only with quads and using one texture. Of course in Blender you should change lots of details strings frets etc. to a shiny material. The guitar strap uses normal vertex-groups left/right/mid and partly a special group the guitar itself uses only the special vertex group. Now it scales with the character. You should see that as a demonstration. When you use the subdivision surface algorithm in MH the fretboard texture becomes distorted dots are moving . This does not happen when you use the subdivision surface algorithm of Blender. The example picture is done with the Blender version.

punkduck_handbag01.author: punkduck
punkduck_handbag01.description: This handbag is created to be suitable for female characters. The size is big enough for a small laptop ... I used the denim jacket as a base for the clothes below the strap. So typically you have to change geometry a bit when you use other clothes. The bag itself is created with a rigid group based on a triangle one vertex near armpit and two near wasteline . For poses you also have to change geometry if the right arm will be near the body. In Blender best reduce the input of the glossy shader from white to grey also change buttons and buckles to a metal-like material.

punkduck_head_mirror.author: punkduck
punkduck_head_mirror.description: This head mirror was created with new make clothes version 2. In Blender you may need some tweaking especially when you work with hair strand hair but also polygon hair . You should change the material of the reflecting parts in Blender e.g. by duplication of material and replacement of the diffuse-shader by a second glossy shader low or zero roughness

punkduck_microphone.author: punkduck
punkduck_microphone.description: If you want to make your character a singer or speaker you can use this microphone using a transmitter so no cable is needed . It is built on rigid groups so it should not deform too much. If you want to be totally sure that the microphone does not deform in Blender you can throw away all vertex groups and recreate the metacarpal2.R and metacarpal3.R group. Set the 2.R to 0.35 and the 3.R to 0.65 for all vertices. For the material you can experiment with the roughness of the glossy shader and the ratio between diffuse and glossy shader.

punkduck_shopping_bag01.author: punkduck
punkduck_shopping_bag01.description: To complete a shopping scene I created one of these gloss coated paper bags. The diffuse-texture containing my logo could be changed to everything you like. The bag is made with rigid groups. I also added a pose to carry this bag and the handbag.

punkduck_stethoscope.author: punkduck
punkduck_stethoscope.description: This stethoscope was created with new makeclothes v2. You should replace the material where metal is used in Blender. When you want to pose the character be aware that the export from MakeHuman also bends the stethoscope. In this case do an export in normal pose and do changes in Blender directly.

punkduck_tennis_racket.author: punkduck
punkduck_tennis_racket.description: I created a tennis racket to complete the scene. You can download a few tennis poses then you will see if it fits. In Blender you may change the frame of the racket to a more glossy material if you want ...

punkduck_wireless_headset.author: punkduck
punkduck_wireless_headset.description: I added a wireless headset. In times of smartphones and earbuds it might look at bit big ... but that's reality because transmitter and battery are built in . The headset was built using one rigid group. It might disappear in a few hairdoes. Use subdivision of a least 2 in Blender.

mindfront_eyebrows_01.author: Mindfront
mindfront_eyebrows_01.description: Mesh high poly eyebrows as an alternative to low poly textured. Instead of using Blender particle eyebrows I decided to make them as mesh to be reusable through MakeHuman. Each hair is non-manifold triangular and goes about 1 mm into the head to avoid visible gaps when posing. Same eyebrows can look awful on some characters and better on other. No texture is needed but they are UV-unwrapped with the roots at the bottom. If you want them darker at the roots and lighter at the tips you can make a BW gradient texture as color mix factor. The preview render is on a default neutral character using subsurf x1 and a simple cycles material.

What coincidence Warning: mesh uses both tris and quads. The current release of MakeHuman doesn't seem to have a problem with it: it shows up correctly and exports correctly to Blender including rigging. You can see some minor squash and stretch when moving the Age slider. I tried several 3-vertex combos on the Hair helper for the rigid fit method and this is the best result of the bunch.

namuhekam_male_polo_shirt.author: namuhekam
namuhekam_male_polo_shirt.description: Basic polo shirt for men. Use a subdivision modifier to improve the appearance of the geometry. Also fits females with additional tweaking to the mesh. Greater deformations in extremes on muscle slider. It has not been tested in older versions of MakeHuman.

toigo_basic_tucked_t-shirt.description: This is a basic T-shirt with the bottom hemline scaled so that the shirt looks tucked into pants. I designed it to be worn with my Wool Pants -- seen in example pic -- http://www.makehumancommunity.org/clothes/wool_pants.html but with a little adjustment it can also be paired with other bottoms. The bump texture is needed for realism. Several other colors are in Materials. Illustration was rendered with subsurf set to two. Model Jerome is also wearing Mindfront's Shoes Monk Strap male http://www.makehumancommunity.org/clothes/shoes_monk_strap_male.html

toigo_bodice-style_top.author: MargaretToigo
toigo_bodice-style_top.description: This is a bodice-style top that will fit most female humans. Some slight adjustments may be needed for senior and plus-size humans. I have included diffuse specular and normal maps and the .mhmat file should get them all imported into Blender where their properties can be adjusted according to preference and render engine. Kendra is also wearing my Tiered Skirt Mini http://www.makehumancommunity.org/clothes/tiered_skirt_mini.html

toigo_camisole_top.description: This is a camisole-style top that will fit female and mostly female humans. It was made with Blender's cloth simulator. A diffuse texture is included. mindfront_knitted_sweater_01.description: Tags: Sweater. Unisex hand knitted sweater. The normal map looks better at lower strength. In Blender use the 'solidify' modifier with 'Thickness' about 4mm and 'Fill Rim' and 'Only Rim' to give it some thickness. Preview image rendered in Blender Cycles.

mindfront_knitted_sweater_02.description: Tags: Sweater. Unisex hand knitted sweater. In Blender use the 'solidify' modifier with 'Thickness' about 4mm and 'Fill Rim' and 'Only Rim' to give it some thickness. Preview image rendered in Blender Cycles.

mindfront_lusekofta.author: Mindfront
mindfront_lusekofta.description: Tags: Female Sweater Cardigan. A Norwegian cardigan 'Lusekofte' ends with an 'a' in Swedish machine knitted wool and front black stripes made of velvet. I found it in a closet never used and wanted to make a virtual version before giving it away. The buttons on the real sweater is loosely fixed with a thread and the buttonholes is a knitted loop. I decided not to add the knitted buttonholes as they wont show behind the buttons. The mesh is low poly and looks best with at least one level of subsurf. I use the slot for displacement for the metal mask texture. In Blender use the Solidify modifier with thickness about 3mm fill rim and only rim to give the fabric some thickness. The preview image is rendered in Blender Cycles.

punkduck_deathnote_t-shirt.author: punkduck
punkduck_deathnote_t-shirt.description: This T-Shirt featuring the japanese manga series 'death note' is made by o4saken. My only work are a few fixes I added a delete group and I upload everything so it should work with MakeHuman directly. The shirt was originally build for a male character but also works for females. Maybe you also have to fix a few vertices in Blender when you combine it with pants. For females it should work with the tight jeans. Please mention o4saken as the real author. The litsphere is used to make the normal map visible. I added diffuse map and normal-map but not the spec-map because it consists of a pattern which is not identical with the cloth itself . For the example picture it was sufficient to connect diffuse-map and glossy shader ... Thanx a lot for this work o4saken

punkduck_lace_up_blouse.description: A long sleeve lace up blouse with a collar which is similar to Edwardian or Victorian style. No delete groups are used because it is 25 transparent looks more transparent in MakeHuman than in Blender . To get the best effect in Blender you should work with translucence. punkduck_off-shoulder_long-sleeve_top.description: This is a rather interesting piece of cloth. It is 10 transparent so no delete-groups are used. The shirt is designed to fit to the tight jeans and the strapless bra. You may change the small rings to a shiny material in Blender. In Makehuman the leather litsphere is used to make the normal-map visible.

drednicolson_asymmetric_tunic_and_sash.author: DredNicolson
drednicolson_asymmetric_tunic_and_sash.description: A sleeveless woman's tunic with asymmetric seams and hem with a sash around the hips. Fitted on the female base human. The diffuse texture is derived from GIMP's built-in Wildflowers pattern and one of my really old procedural textures where I was attempting to make wood and not succeeding makes pretty good stripes though . The normal and specular maps come from a desaturated fabric photo and an old pattern where I literally modelled thread with lots and lots of tiny cylinders. A grayscale bump map was baked first then I used that to bake normals. Most skirts/pants/underwear should fit underneath with no or minor clipping and there's enough mesh density in the chest area to fit most ahem cup sizes. Known Issues - Minor clipping or odd deformations occur in front of the armpits when the shoulders are rolled you can see it on the Benchmark or other extreme arm poses . For now it's easy enough to hot-fix in Blender until I figure out which helper verts are the guilty party. Plans - Add a tie for the sash. This might be better done as a separate accessory.

drednicolson_short-tail_camo_tee.author: DredNicolson
drednicolson_short-tail_camo_tee.description: A casual shirt with the tail not quite reaching the hips fully modeled seams and a camouflage pattern. Fitted on the female base human. Works okay for males too albeit with a 'shrunk in the wash' look. The camo was created with procedural textures multiplied down with a light AO map and then baked to an image. The specular map emphasizes self-shadowing in the seams. The normal map simulates individual stitches to produce a fabric-like sheen. The effect is more like satin than cotton but close enough. The chest area readily adapts to standard breast targets though minor clipping can occur with extreme combinations. Known Issues - A bit of ugly deformation in the armpits. Can be hot-fixed in Blender with Subsurf and Corrective Smooth modifiers.

mindfront_tank_top_01.description: Tags: Casual Sport. punkduck_retro_top.description: This is a typical 50s top. In reality it is convertible from a square neckline to a off shoulder neckline. It should be combined with the retro polka dot skirt. Normal map is added to create the pleats of the sleeves. The normal map is made visible by using the leather litsphere. In Blender the litsphere does not matter. Delete groups are used.

punkduck_sleeveless_crop_top.description: This crop top should fit to most of the dresses. This 'initial' version is colored white like most of the t-shirts you can buy so it could be simply changed to a new color or pattern. Delete groups are use. You should connect the input of the glossy shader to the output of the image texture.

punkduck_sleeveless_shirt.author: punkduck
punkduck_sleeveless_shirt.description: The sleeveless shirt should be used for female characters. You may combine it with the jeans or minirock. As a material I tried a combination of normal-map and diffuse-texture which works in MH itself. So I took the leather litsphere. When you export it to blender the litsphere does not matter because the materials and textures are added as always. I added a picture in the forum tutorials/coloring white texture... how you change the material in Blender cycles to display every color you want and also how to change the details. The shirt uses the delete-group. All 5 buttons of the shirt resize geometrically Scale down the 4th button when you use bigger cup-sizes in Blender. Select all buttons in Blender and attach a new more shiny material e.g. put a math-node 0.5 clamp between fresnel and mix-shader .

punkduck_spaghetti_strap_tank_top.description: This tank top is designed for the jeans skirt. Maybe you have to make some corrections in Blender because I tried to let it not appear too bulky. I added a picture in the forum tutorials/coloring white texture... how you change the material in Blender cycles to display every color you want. The shirt uses the delete-group.

mtknife_pleated_mini_skirt.author: MTKnife
mtknife_pleated_mini_skirt.description: I really wanted to do pleats by creating a mesh in the right shape rather than using normals....It took me close to two years off and on to figure out how to do that. The pleats are in fact folded just like real knife pleats a good guide for making the real thing is https://www.carbonchic.com.au/2014/11/diy-knife-pleated-skirt/ or rather one pleat was folded and then repeated along a bezier curve made from an edge loop in the skirt helper this introduced some distortions in size but they're not horrible . The mesh was designed with quads then transformed to tris using 'poke faces' before being exported as clothes in order to deal with the non-planar faces necessarily created by the folding. The peculiar format of the UV map is also due to folding the mesh like real pleats: to get pixels to end up in the right places the texture needs to be a long strip just like a real pleated skirt is made from a long strip of fabric. Finally note that if you want to do a cloth simulation on the skirt you'll need to do some pinning as the pleats aren't actually attached to the waistband. Credits: In the included material the plaid texture comes from heartlessinu at DeviantArt https://www.deviantart.com/heartlessinu/art/Red-plaid-215324313 while the zipper is from fuzzimo http://www.fuzzimo.com/free-hi-res-zipper-textures-pictures/ . mindfront_f_ninja.author: Mindfront
mindfront_f_ninja.description: Tags: Female Work Sport. This is my interpretation of a female ninja outfit. Recommended accessories is the 'Katana Kill Bill ' made by punkduck. The hood was difficult to get to deform nicely so I decided to assign it as rigid body not the best solution as the hood is flattened when rotating the head to look up I maybe correct that some time. Other parts may be oddly deformed but for the moment the best I could do. Some texture stretching is noticeable but not too disturbing in my point of view. The face mask is transparent and if you dont want that just remove the usage of alpha on the diffuse texture. The outfit looks best with at least one level of subsurf and is already solidified.

mindfront_m_suit_01.author: Mindfront
mindfront_m_suit_01.description: Tags: Male Elegant. Tailored suit but the shirt and tie are fake. The normal map do most of the other details. I made the buttons three vertex hard body but I could't get them to work in all situations without them loosing their shape and location. If the buttons are important you could get them from the OBJ-file and place them manually. The textures is primary made for subsurf level 2 in Blender. If you use Blender try the Solidify modifier with 'Fill Rim' and 'Only Rim' to give the fabric some thickness. For fast specular setup in Blender Cycles set the specular map to 'Non-Color Data' connect the color output to the upper value input of a 'Math'-node set it to 'Power' and the value to about 5 and then use the output of the 'Math'-node as mixfactor between Diffuse BSDF/Glossy BSDF shader. The tie print is from Maialisa on pixabay.com CC0 Public Domain.

punkduck_diver_suit.author: punkduck
punkduck_diver_suit.description: This diver suit is a co-production of grinsegold who made the geometry and myself. So most of the credits are for him. In Blender you should change the materials a bit. Insert the color output of the texture to the glossy shader. For the weights you can duplicate the material then delete the fresnel and use a fixed value. In the end you should decrease the roughness of the glossy shader. That's the way the example picture was done. Delete groups are used only face and hands are left. Be aware that the weights deform when changing the geometry. An additional material is available. Use this asset with the diver scuba rig.

v0rt3x_armsleeves_black_fishnet_large.author: V0rT3X
v0rt3x_armsleeves_black_fishnet_large.description: Tip : the armsleeves come in 6 different variations. For a better overview you can make it changeable under the Material Tab instead of Clothes. Create therefore just one folder under ../v1/data/clothes/ name it for example armsleeves_fishnet and copy all files of one variation into it. Take for example armsleeves_fishnet_large as the main files. Rename them to armsleeves_fishnet and edit the .mhclo file to match the new names. E.g. rename armsleeves_fishnet_large.obj to armsleeves_fishnet.obj rename armsleeves_fishnet_large.mhmat to armsleeves_fishnet.mhmat etc. Change the new names within the .mhclo files too. IMPORTANT: DO NOT RENAME THE .PNG FILE unless you're willing to edit its name within the .mhmat file too Create then a subfolder named materials and within it create 5 additional subfolders named after your choice. For example: armsleeves_fishnet_medium armsleeves_fishnet_small etc. Now copy only three files of each version the .mhmat the .thumb and the .png into the appropriate subfolder. For example copy armsleeves_fishnet_medium.mhmat armsleeves_fishnet_medium.thumb and armsleeves_fishnet_medium.png into the armsleeves_fishnet_medium subfolder delete the .mhclo and the .obj file. And now the important part rename the .mhmat and the .thumb file to match the name in the main folder so that the main .mhclo file could find it in this case rename it to armsleeves_fishnet.mhmat and armsleeves_fishnet.thumb again leave the .png file unless you're willing to edit it's name within the .mhmat file . elvs_bow_bottom_panty.description: An underwear bottom lingerie with a bow and lace design for female makehuman models. One texture included. Tri mesh but loads in makehuman the same.

elvs_bow_front_bra.author: Elvaerwyn
elvs_bow_front_bra.description: A lingerie bra for makehuman female models with a bow and half cups. One texture included. Tri mesh but loads in makehuman the same. Works with Bow butt panty.

elvs_crude_bootyshorts.description: A pair of crochet booty shorts/bloomers for female makehuman models to wear under baby doll. Basic quad mesh low poly. One texture setup included.

elvs_lace_panty.author: Elvaerwyn
elvs_lace_panty.description: A lingerie style panty with lace and bow for makehuman female models. Tri mesh but loads in mh the same. One texture included. Made to go with camisole top.

mindfront_bikini_01.author: Mindfront
mindfront_bikini_01.description: Tags: Female Swimwear. This bikini is also included in F Beach Dress 01. I have not made any effort in the material settings.

punkduck_babydoll.author: punkduck
punkduck_babydoll.description: A typical version of a babydoll or neglig. This babydoll should be used with string 2. Another 'light' material is added to the materials section. The default material should be used with blender it looks more realistic. The light material is designed for the same effect in makehuman. You also have to edit the small tie in front after importing the dress into blender when you use a female with a bigger cup-size. The tie becomes smaller when the breast size increases but the geometry is not changed. So by selecting all vertices of the tie in Blender it is simple to make modifications.

punkduck_bandeau_bikini_bra.author: punkduck
punkduck_bandeau_bikini_bra.description: This part of the Bikini should be combined with the bandeau bikini slip . It will not fit on extrem cup-sizes and also looks weird when you put it on kids ... A few elements of the bra are placed on special vertex-groups so that these are not distorted but it is possible that these elements look like loose geometry. After importings these elements to blender change the material of the small 'pyramids' to brass. Delete-groups are used. As a material I tried a combination of normal-map and diffuse-texture which works in MH itself. So I took the leather litsphere. When you export it to blender the litsphere does not matter because the materials and textures are added as always.

punkduck_bandeau_bikini_slip.author: punkduck
punkduck_bandeau_bikini_slip.description: This part of the Bikini should be combined with the bandeau bikini bra . A few elements of the slip are placed on special vertex-groups so that these are not distorted but it is possible that these elements look like loose geometry. After importings these elements to blender change the material of the small 'pyramids' to brass. Delete-groups are used. As a material I tried a combination of normal-map and diffuse-texture which works in MH itself. So I took the leather litsphere. When you export it to blender the litsphere does not matter because the materials and textures are added as always.

punkduck_bandeau_bra.author: punkduck
punkduck_bandeau_bra.description: The Bandeau is part of a lingerie set the second part is string4. Best fit on female characters with small to mid sized breasts. In reality it makes no sense for large breast. The Bandeau bra especially allows poses where straps of normal bra will get distorted e.g. arm behind head . A white texture will be added to extra materials.

punkduck_bikini02_bra.author: punkduck
punkduck_bikini02_bra.description: This part of the Bikini should be combined with the Bikini-02 slip . It will not fit on extrem cup-sizes and also looks weird when you put it on kids ... Delete-groups are used. As a material I tried a combination of normal-map and diffuse-texture which works in MH itself. So I took the leather litsphere. When you export it to blender the litsphere does not matter because the materials and textures are added as always.

punkduck_bikini02_slip.author: punkduck
punkduck_bikini02_slip.description: This part of the Bikini should be combined with the Bikini-02 bra . Delete-groups are used. As a material I tried a combination of normal-map and diffuse-texture which works in MH itself. So I took the leather litsphere. When you export it to blender the litsphere does not matter because the materials and textures are added as always.

punkduck_brazilian_bikini_bra.author: punkduck
punkduck_brazilian_bikini_bra.description: This part of the Bikini should be combined with the brazilian bikini slip . It will not fit on extrem cup-sizes and also looks weird when you put it on kids ... A few elements of the bra are placed on special vertex-groups so that these are not distorted but it is possible that these elements look like loose geometry. After importings these elements to blender change the material of spheres rings and end sleeves to brass. The cylinder is a plastic material. Delete-groups are used. No normal map appended so far.

punkduck_brazilian_bikini_slip.author: punkduck
punkduck_brazilian_bikini_slip.description: This part of the Bikini should be combined with the brazilian bikini bra . After importing the slip to blender change the material of the end sleeves to brass. Delete-groups are used. No normal map appended so far.

punkduck_french_lingerie_bra.author: punkduck
punkduck_french_lingerie_bra.description: The french lingerie bra is part of a set containing briefs stockings suspender-belt and bra. Best fit on female characters with small to mid sized breasts. A black texture is added to extra materials. You also should change the small rings at the back to a shiny metal. Edit: a normal map is added.

punkduck_french_lingerie_mini_briefs.author: punkduck
punkduck_french_lingerie_mini_briefs.description: The french lingerie mini briefs is part of a set containing briefs stockings suspender-belt and bra. A black texture is added to extra materials. Edit: normal map is supplied.

punkduck_french_lingerie_stockings.author: punkduck
punkduck_french_lingerie_stockings.description: The french lingerie stockings is part of a set containing briefs stockings suspender-belt and bra. A black material is also available. In Blender reduce glossiness and connect input of the glossy shader to the texture. No delete groups are used so skin may peek through in certain poses.

punkduck_french_lingerie_suspender_belt.author: punkduck
punkduck_french_lingerie_suspender_belt.description: The french lingerie suspender-belt also called garter belt is part of a set containing briefs stockings suspender-belt and bra. A black material is added also.

punkduck_french_lingerie_thong.author: punkduck
punkduck_french_lingerie_thong.description: The french lingerie thong could be used alternatively instead of the mini briefs. A black texture is added to extra materials.

punkduck_frill_bikini_bottom.author: punkduck
punkduck_frill_bikini_bottom.description: This part of the Bikini should be combined with the frill bikini top. Delete-groups are used. Normalmap is added. Some of the faces could be viewed from both sides. Edit: see material setup for the frill bikini top how to change the material setup in Blender.

punkduck_frill_bikini_top.author: punkduck
punkduck_frill_bikini_top.description: This part of the Bikini should be combined with the frill bikini bottom. Delete-groups are used. Normalmap is added. Some of the faces could be viewed from both sides. Edit: An example to change the setup so that the normalmap is not acting on the backside is supplied as bump texture.

punkduck_sport_bra.author: punkduck
punkduck_sport_bra.description: I created a sport bra for female characters which can be also used as a special top for yoga or pole-dance. Best to use this bra with small to mid cup sizes. For bigger cup sizes you should modify the result in Blender. A normal map is added in MakeHuman I use the leather litsphere to make it visible. In Blender the litsphere does not matter. Delete groups are used. Sport briefs are also available. If you want to use the bra as a top you should use the red pole-dance-material.

punkduck_sport_briefs.author: punkduck
punkduck_sport_briefs.description: Since it is weird to wear fine lingerie under e.g. a tennis dress I created sport briefs for female characters. Edit: A normal map is added in MakeHuman I use the leather litsphere to make it visible. Delete groups are used. A sport bra is also available. If you want to use these briefs without an additional dress you should use the red pole-dance material.

punkduck_string_2.author: punkduck
punkduck_string_2.description: String 2 could be used with the transparent bra or the babydoll provided by me. It was made mainly for the babydoll and is not very detailed ...

punkduck_string_4.author: punkduck
punkduck_string_4.description: String 4 should be used with the Bandeau bra. It also should fit under the cocktaildress. A white texture will be added in the material section.

punkduck_string_5.author: punkduck
punkduck_string_5.description: Sorry for using my enumeration .... String 5 is part of a set the other part is the pushup bra. In Blender using cycles render connect the color input of the glossy shader to the texture and use a value of 0.4 for the mix shader instead of the fresnel input to get the same result shown in the example picture. Delete vertex groups are used.

punkduck_teddy_erotic_lingerie.author: punkduck
punkduck_teddy_erotic_lingerie.description: This teddy is made for female characters. I used delete_groups so that faces in some regions should not poke through. After exporting this to Blender you normally should edit the distorted rings this will happen when your model has bigger cupsizes and change the material of the rings. You also should make the whole material a little bit more shiny when you use the normal map. An example of the cycles shader setup is placed in the forum.

punkduck_female_strapless_bodysuit.author: punkduck
punkduck_female_strapless_bodysuit.description: This rather simple strapless bodysuit should be used for female characters. Normally it is used as a shape-wear but you can use it for different purposes e.g. as part of a costume . It is designed to fit with the ballet tights. Delete groups are used and a normal map is added and made visible in makehuman using the leather litsphere.

punkduck_halterneck_romper.author: punkduck
punkduck_halterneck_romper.description: From Wikipedia: 'while rompers had been popular in among women in the 1950s they re-emerged in the 1970s as a fashion for adult women. In the 1970s rompers were usually a casual garment made of terrycloth and often in a tube top style. They were common in the 1980s in a wider variety of materials. Since 2006 rompers have enjoyed a minor renaissance as a fashionable garment for women.' I made a romper with a halterneck. A normalmap is supplied and delete groups are used. Nevertheless it could happen that skin peeks through. Best fit on female characters with small to midsize breasts.

punkduck_one_piece_bikini01.author: punkduck
punkduck_one_piece_bikini01.description: This is a one piece bikini. It is colored white and there is a node setup supplied so that you can recolor it e.g. like in 'Baywatch' . There is also advice how to use the shrinkwrap modifier to make it skin-tight. A normal-map is also supplied. Delete-groups are used. Be aware to switch them off when you will work with transparency. There are also two methods to simulate a wet swimsuit one is simply to reduce roughness of the glossy node. There is also a second texture added where transparency is used except where the seams and crotch-area are. This is more 'sexy'. Be aware that for a dark color you need less transparency to make the skin visible. But decide yourself which way you like ...

punkduck_shapewear.author: punkduck
punkduck_shapewear.description: This colorful shapewear I made for a user request. You should combine it with the black bandeau bra. Deletegroups are used. To create the shiny effects a normal map 4 times as big as the diffuse texture is added. In MH the leather litsphere is used to make the effect visible.

joepal_crude_high_socks.description: The crude series of clothes are intended as starting points for further development. Each piece comes with a plain diffuse texture where the faces have been painted plain white. If you modify or texture paint one of the pieces in this series and want to share just upload it again here as if you were the original author of it.
